t.why: About 5% of world seaborne trade passes through the canal. In 2025 the United States raised the question of control of the canal again, causing friction.
t.rel: The country linking the Atlantic and the Pacific through the Panama Canal. It took over the canal from the United States in 1999, and in 2025 the United States raised the question of control again, causing friction.
t.korea: Many ships built in Korean shipyards pass through the canal, and Korean companies took part in its expansion.
t.know: Ships climb through locks to Gatun Lake, about 26 m above sea level, then descend on the other side.
t.etext: Panama Canal tolls, ports, finance and logistics are the heart of the economy. It uses the US dollar, and its ship registry is among the largest in the world.
